description: छपा संस्करण: Bibliotheca Indica खंड 8, 'The Ísá, Kéna, Katha, Praśna, Muṇḍa, Máṇḍukya Upanishads, with the commentary of Sankara Áchárya, and the gloss of Ánanda Giri', संपादक E.
